shipped_rows.title_o: The fate of primary memory items in free recall

blind_target.title: Positive recency in delayed free recall
blind_target.evidence_quote: Given that previous studies (e.g. Tzeng, 1973 ; Bjork & Whitten, 1974 ) found mixed results, we reexamined the negative-recency effect in final-free recall following both CDFR lists and DFR lists in which there was no inter-item distractor.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The authors reexamine the prior CDFR findings jointly, but say only that previous studies had mixed results. They do not identify Tzeng’s original negative-recency result separately, so its agreement with the present robust negative recency cannot be determined.

blind_target.title: Recency-sensitive retrieval processes in long-term free recall

blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The prior CDFR studies are jointly described as yielding mixed results without assigning individual findings. Present negative recency is clear, but agreement with this specific original is not established in the supplied article.
